# Halaman produk recipe

Review or demo of one named thing (app, tool, book, product) staged as a product page. White pages hold the thing: its real picture, the rebuilt screen the speaker describes, hairline drawings of the nouns. A virtual camera moves inside each page on the speaker's words. The speaker's face, left as shot, delivers only lines aimed at the viewer: full frame under big white two-tier chest captions, or cut out over a rounded footage card on a soft white-to-grey page (hook and splits). Over pages, one spoken word at a time sits in a grey pill. Titles are two tiers that touch: heavy sans, then a big italic serif payoff. Ending is flat.

## Rules

1. Show, do not tell. Each "what" or "how" line becomes a page: the real picture, a rebuilt UI state, or a hairline sketch of the noun. The thing's own colour is the only accent.
2. Face = lines to the viewer: claim, reason, encouragement. Full frame as shot, or the cut-out over a rounded card when a page shares the screen. In a talking-head film the face is on screen 45% or more.
3. One caption voice per layer. Footage: two-tier white chest captions. Page, split or UI: the single spoken word in the grey pill. Page title: black two-tier. Never two systems together; the pill goes off while a title is up.
4. Cut hard on a sentence's opening word. Everything else is a camera move inside the page. The face gets only a slow linear push.
5. The demo performs the line. A press, toggle or hop hits the naming word within 2 frames.

Not an ad: no price bursts, stickers, shouting type. Not a screen recording with a bubble in the corner. Not a slideshow of product shots. Skip grade, grain, vignette, text stroke, text shadow, pill shadow. No comment-keyword call to action, no outro card.

## Footage and words

- Source: the user's talking-head clip from `list_media`, as shot.
- Hook and splits: run `make_cutout` on those windows (6 s max each) and lay the `cut_…webm` over the clip using the cutout timing rule.
- Hook card clip: `clip-path: inset(1290px 18px 0 18px round 66px)`. Split: plate scaled 0.87 into `inset(1390px 70px 0 70px round 60px)`. Leave the cut-out unclipped so the head breaks out through the top of the card.
- Move clip and cut-out down together until the head top sits just under the headline (hook) or at least 18 px below the pill (split).
- Face beats: clip full frame, scrim from y 1125 (black 44% to 52%). Reframe a horizontal clip to 9:16 (craft `reframe.md`).
- Pill and chest captions follow the transcript from `inspect_media` (`words: [{text, start, end}]`). Confirm product name, prices and numbers with the user.
- The example paints a stand-in speaker once (room and person on separate layers). Swap in the user's clip and cut-out.

## Pages and objects

- Page ground: flat `--latar` white. Hook page fades white to grey from 46% of its height. Split page is `--latar-2`, fading to grey from 62%.
- Shadows: soft drop shadows on objects only (pictures, icons, panels, alerts). Never on type.
- The real thing: the photo, cover, app icon or screenshot the user uploads, on white with a soft shadow. If none exists, draw it.
- Hairline drawings: SVG, 3 px lines in three greys (`--teks` at 42 / 32 / 22% on the page) plus one black active part (filled tile or black stroke) that lives, hopping, rocking or filling on its word. Draw isometric boxes, an exploded phone, a receipt, a bell, a shelf fresh for each film. No clip art.
- Rebuilt UI: alerts, lists, toggles set in the page's own type (Inter stands in for a phone's system font) on settings grey `--latar-2`, with the action in the accent.
- Hook file card: dark, 620 x 210, radius 16, y 262-472. Row 1 the name; row 2 a chevron plus what it is. The thing's picture or icon sits as a badge on the top-right corner.

## Palette

- `--utama`: accent, the thing's own colour as it appears on screen (sample from the photo or logo). Use on the app-icon badge, the drawing's active part, the action in a rebuilt alert. An accent word on white takes `--utama-di-latar`.
- `--aksen`: accent at about 45% on white, for highlights and a pressed row.
- `--latar`: white page. `--latar-2`: UI grey and split page. `--teks`: black of titles and the active part. `--teks-redup`: grey sub-labels.
- Fixed in every brand: dark file card (`--kartu`, text `--kartu-teks` and `--kartu-sub`), grey pill (black 45%, white words), white chest captions over footage (`--putih`). These sit on footage or translucent black, so they ignore the brand.
- Dark brand: pages go dark, hairlines go pale, the accent still marks a single thing.

## Type

- `--font-judul`, weight 800, letter-spacing -1 px. Hook headline tiers 80 px (fit 860 px). Page title tier A 96 px (fit 720 px). Chest captions 84 px (fit 860 px). Inter 800 works; any heavy grotesk will do.
- Serif payoff: Playfair Display Italic. Hook 108 px, chest captions 124 px, page title tier B 150-168 px (fit 860 px). Tier B starts directly under tier A, no gap.
- `--font-isi`: pill at 600, 66 px, -0.6 px, white, inside a 96 px pill radius 10 with 16 px side padding, slot y 1098-1194. File card 600 at 48 / 40 px. Rebuilt UI: alert title 600 44 px, body 400 32 px, buttons 600 40 px.
- Labels state plain facts only: a name, title, author, app name, contact. Captions stay at 48 px or larger.

## Motion

Frame rate 30 (durations measured at 25 fps stay in seconds). Cut within 0.1 s of a sentence's first word; each new sentence gets a new layer.

- Page arrival, measured push: scale 0.654 to 1.0 in 12 hard steps of 0.04 s.
- Title zoom-out: x0.74-0.78, `power3.inOut`, 0.9 s, anchored near the top. Title then rises.
- Detail push: x1.23, `expo.out`, 0.52 s, on the word naming the detail. Drift. Then accelerate into the cut at x0.87, `power2.in`.
- Entrances use `expo.out`, no overshoot. Picture rises from 1,350 px below in 0.96 s. Split panel slides in from the right over 0.9-1.8 s. Icon drops from 560 px above in 0.88 s. Opacity ramps linear. The one settle is the file card: y -13, -20, 0 in 0.44 s.
- Page title: tier A rises 280 px, `expo.out`, 0.58 s, each letter fading in and sharpening (blur 8 to 0 over 0.14 s, 0.024 s stagger). Tier B wipes left to right from a 10% ghost, 0.2 s per letter, 0.024 s stagger, starting on its spoken word.
- Chest captions: every word blurs in at onset (opacity 0, y 18, blur 6 to 0 in 0.16 s, `power2.out`). Phrases swap hard.
- Pill: swaps hard one frame after the word starts; holds through pauses.
- Hook exit: from end - 0.32 s the card grows x1.14 and drifts 73 px down (`power2.in`, 0.44 s). Footage and cut-out wash to white in 0.16 s. Headline cuts on the last frame.
- Whip between drawings: one strip, outgoing x 0 to -1100, incoming 1100 to 0, in 0.04 s steps, landing on the incoming word.
- UI actions land on the verb: press for 1-2 frames, toggle knob 0.2 s `power2.inOut` four frames after the word, highlight 8 frames.
- Face beats: linear push x1.03-1.05 across the beat. Each drawing loops something small (a 0.3 s hop, a bob, steam).

## Camera moves

- Measured push 0.654 to 1 in 12 steps: the page loads like a product page. Every page entrance.
- Zoom-out x0.76 `power3.inOut`: clear room for the title, sum up. After a drawing or list.
- Detail push x1.23 `expo.out`: "this part". A cover title, a feature, a price.
- Accelerate into the cut x0.87: hand off to the next sentence. Last beat of a page.
- Panel in from the right, `expo.out`: the demo joins the speaker. A step the viewer should do.
- Whip strip: next item in a list. Drawings in a stack.
- Slow linear push x1.03-1.05: stay with the person. Face beats.
- Wash to white: leave the hook. Once, right after the hook.

## Signature moves

- Product-page hook: dark file card naming the thing with its icon or cover as a badge; three-tier headline (two sans, one serif payoff); the head breaking out of a rounded footage card on the white-to-grey page. All present on frame 0. Use for an app review ("Aplikasi ini bikin stok tokoku rapi lagi"), a teacher's book pick, a creator's camera, a cafe's new menu.
- Hairline page, one live part: three-grey drawing of the noun, one black part hopping or filling on its word, measured push, zoom-out, two-tier title. Use for an exploded phone with a stock tile, a recipe pot with rising steam, a study timetable, a story's house with one window lit.
- Split with rebuilt UI: cut-out over a smaller footage card at the bottom; a white panel slides from the right with the screen being described; press lands on its verb; pill carries the word. Use for a stock alert and "Pesan lagi", switching off notifications, a booking confirmation, a quiz's answer button.
- The real thing rises: photo or cover comes up from below, pushes to the named detail, accelerates into the cut. Use for a coffee bag's roast date, a book title, a phone case's corner, a ticket's seat number.
- Gallery payoff: the film's own drawings as a tile grid (316 x 370, radius 22, thin border). One tile changes on the payoff word (a pile becomes a stack, a tile shrinks to one cell). White veil, two-tier title, plain-fact label. Use for "Toko rapi, hati tenang", "Satu kebiasaan, satu bulan", "Kelas selesai, nilai naik".

## Avoid

- Describing on the face what a page should show. Each named thing or step earns a page.
- Pill together with a title or chest captions; pill over the speaker's head; sounds or animation per pill.
- Filters or punch-ins on the face. Slow linear push only.
- More than one accent, or an accent that is not the thing's own colour.
- Text shadow, stroke, pill shadow, grain, vignette, grade.
- Clip art, stock icons, stock video on pages. Draw for the line.
- Pages over about 6 s; more than about 3 inserts a minute; face below 45% in a talking-head film.
- Claims the speaker did not make; em dashes on screen; comment-keyword call to action.

## Reference numbers

- Geometry at 1080 x 1920: hook card inset 1290 / 18 / 0 / 18, radius 66. Split card inset 1390 / 70 / 0 / 70, radius 60, at x0.87. Split panel x 150-1150, y -60 to 1065, radius 64 bottom-left. Pill slot y 1098-1194. Chest captions start y 1150, never below 1500. File card y 262-472. Hook headline starts y 500. Gallery cells 316 x 370 at x 24 / 382 / 740 and y 300 / 712 / 1124.
- Approved film: face 48% (hook cut-out, two splits, three face beats), pages 52%, longest page 5.8 s.
- Detail push x1.23 ran 13 reference frames; title tier A rise 280 px ran 14.5 reference frames.
- Sound: 3.6-4.3 effects per 10 s, only on entrances and UI actions, within 2 frames. Pop on the hook card at frame 0, soft whoosh leading the hook wash, click on a press, tick per toggle. Silence on pill swaps, caption words, bare cuts and the payoff title.

# Product page: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.4, long 3.4.

## hook

- en: frame 0 names the thing: a dark file card with an icon badge, a three-tier headline, the head breaking out of a rounded footage card
- id: frame 0 menyebut bendanya: kartu berkas gelap dengan lencana ikon, judul tiga tingkat, kepala pembicara keluar dari kartu rekaman bulat

## problem

- en: the speaker full frame as shot, a slow linear push, white two-tier chest captions with the payoff word in serif italic
- id: pembicara penuh layar apa adanya, dorongan linear pelan, caption dada putih dua tingkat dengan kata payoff serif miring

## fact

- en: a white page with a hairline drawing of the noun, one black part alive; measured push in, a zoom-out, a two-tier title
- id: halaman putih dengan gambar garis tipis bendanya, satu bagian hitam hidup; dorong masuk bertahap, zoom keluar, judul dua tingkat

## step

- en: split: the speaker cut out over a smaller footage card, a white panel slides in with the rebuilt UI; each action lands on its verb
- id: split: pembicara terpotong di atas kartu rekaman kecil, panel putih masuk membawa UI; tiap aksi jatuh tepat pada kata kerjanya

## compare

- en: two hairline drawings joined by a whip, each arriving on its noun, the better one gets the black part
- id: dua gambar garis disambung sapuan cepat, tiap gambar datang pada katanya, yang lebih baik mendapat bagian hitam

## number

- en: the rebuilt UI row whose number changes on its word, the pill carrying the spoken figure
- id: baris UI yang angkanya berganti pada katanya, pil membawa angka yang diucapkan

## proof

- en: the real picture of the thing rises from below onto the white page, pushes to the detail on the word that names it
- id: gambar asli bendanya naik dari bawah ke halaman putih, mendorong ke detailnya pada kata yang menyebutnya

## offer

- en: the product's picture on the page with its price as the serif tier of a two-tier title
- id: gambar produk di halaman dengan harganya sebagai tingkat serif judul dua tingkat

## cta

- en: a two-tier title on the white page, a plain-fact label with the name and contact under it, held 2 s
- id: judul dua tingkat di halaman putih, label fakta berisi nama dan kontak di bawahnya, diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: a gallery of the video's own drawings, one changes on the payoff word, a veil, a two-tier title; held flat
- id: galeri gambar-gambar video ini, satu berubah pada kata payoff, tirai, judul dua tingkat; diam datar

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Halaman produk</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Playfair Display"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama.
         --latar = halaman putih, --latar-2 = abu halaman UI, --utama = warna produk (satu aksen), --aksen = aksen 45 % untuk sorotan. */
      :root {
        --latar: #fdfdfd; --latar-2: #f2f2f7; --utama: #d94c5f; --aksen: #eeaeb7;
        --teks: #0f0e0e; --teks-redup: #8e8e92; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff; --teks-di-aksen: #0f0e0e;
        --utama-di-latar: #c43a4f; --aksen-di-latar: #b4566a;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya, tetap di semua brand: kartu berkas gelap, pil kata, caption di atas rekaman, warna rekaman pengganti. */
        --kartu: #181519; --kartu-teks: #ffffff; --kartu-sub: #bdbdbd; --hitam: #000000; --putih: #ffffff;
        --f-dinding: #d8c7b0; --f-dinding2: #8c7a66; --f-jendela: #fff3d6; --f-kulit: #c68c69; --f-kulit2: #7f4e36;
        --f-rambut: #1c1512; --f-baju: #3d3a38; --f-baju2: #1e1c1b; --f-daun: #56704a; --f-kayu: #6b4a33; --f-bibir: #5e2a22;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .full, .plate img, .orang img { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      /* Rekaman: ruang (kartu terpotong) dan orangnya (cutout, di depan kartu). */
      .plate, .orang { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; transform-origin: 0 0; }
      .fitur { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: visible; }
      .mata { fill: var(--f-rambut); } .alis { fill: none; stroke: var(--f-rambut); stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .mulut { fill: var(--f-bibir); }
      .klip-hook { position: absolute; inset: 0; clip-path: inset(1290px 18px 0px 18px round 66px); }
      .klip-split { position: absolute; inset: 0; clip-path: inset(1390px 70px 0px 70px round 60px); }
      /* Halaman: hook putih ke abu, split abu, halaman produk putih. */
      .hal-hook { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--latar) 0%, var(--latar) 45.8%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 6%, var(--latar)) 52%,
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 20%, var(--latar)) 58%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 36%, var(--latar)) 64.6%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 52%, var(--latar)) 100%); }
      .hal-split { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--latar-2) 0%, var(--latar-2) 61.5%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 12%, var(--latar-2)) 74%,
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 30%, var(--latar-2)) 86.5%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 38%, var(--latar-2)) 100%); }
      /* Kartu berkas hook: judul benda, sub abu, lencana ikon aplikasinya. */
      #berkas { position: absolute; left: 230px; top: 262px; width: 620px; height: 210px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--kartu); text-align: center; }
      #berkas b { display: block; margin-top: 46px; font: 600 48px/1.2 var(--font-isi); color: var(--kartu-teks); }
      #berkas span { display: block; margin-top: 10px; font: 600 40px/1.2 var(--font-isi); color: var(--kartu-sub); }
      #lencana { position: absolute; right: -40px; top: -44px; width: 140px; height: 140px; border-radius: 32px; background: var(--utama);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 26px color-mix(in oklab, var(--hitam) 30%, transparent); }
      .judul { position: absolute; left: 110px; right: 110px; text-align: center; color: var(--teks); }
      .sans { display: block; font: 800 80px/1.02 var(--font-judul); letter-spacing: -1px; white-space: nowrap; }
      .serif { display: block; font: italic 400 108px/1 "Playfair Display", serif; white-space: nowrap; }
      .t-a { font-size: 96px; } .t-b { font-size: 150px; line-height: 0.98; }
      .t-a i, .t-b i { font-style: inherit; display: inline-block; opacity: 0; }
      /* Caption dada di atas rekaman: dua-tiga tingkat, putih, payoff serif. */
      .scrim { background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0px, transparent 1125px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--hitam) 44%, transparent) 1195px, color-mix(in oklab, var(--hitam) 52%, transparent) 1920px); }
      .dada { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 1150px; text-align: center; color: var(--putih); font: 800 84px/1.02 var(--font-judul); }
      .dada span { display: inline-block; opacity: 0; }
      .dada .sans { font-size: 84px; } .dada .serif { font-size: 124px; margin-top: -4px; }
      /* Pil abu: satu kata yang sedang diucapkan, slot tetap y 1098–1194. */
      .pil { position: absolute; top: 1098px; height: 96px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px;
        background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--hitam) 45%, transparent); color: var(--putih); font: 600 66px/96px var(--font-isi); letter-spacing: -0.6px;
        white-space: nowrap; visibility: hidden; }
      /* Gambar garis tipis: abu tiga tingkat, satu bagian hitam yang hidup. */
      .gb { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: visible; }
      .h1, .h2, .h3, .ak { fill: none; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .h1 { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 42%, var(--latar)); } .h2 { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 32%, var(--latar)); }
      .h3 { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 22%, var(--latar)); } .ak { stroke: var(--teks); stroke-width: 4; }
      .isi-ak { fill: var(--teks); } .isi-utama { fill: var(--utama); } .isi-latar { fill: var(--latar); }
      .cam { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 540px 300px; }
      /* Panel putih split, UI dibangun ulang (peringatan). */
      #panel { position: absolute; left: 150px; top: -60px; width: 1000px; height: 1125px; border-radius: 0 0 0 64px; background: var(--latar);
        box-shadow: -40px 30px 90px color-mix(in oklab, var(--hitam) 16%, transparent); }
      #alert { position: absolute; left: 120px; top: 420px; width: 680px; border-radius: 34px; background: var(--latar-2); text-align: center; overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 50px color-mix(in oklab, var(--hitam) 10%, transparent); }
      #alert h3 { margin-top: 44px; font: 600 44px/1.2 var(--font-isi); } #alert p { margin: 12px 40px 36px; font: 400 32px/1.35 var(--font-isi); color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .tombol { display: flex; border-top: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 12%, var(--latar-2)); }
      .tombol div { position: relative; flex: 1; padding: 26px 0; font: 600 40px/1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .tombol div + div + div { border-left: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 12%, var(--latar-2)); }
      #tekan { position: absolute; padding: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 50%; height: 92px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 16%, var(--latar-2)); opacity: 0; }
      #bel { position: absolute; left: 400px; top: 170px; width: 120px; height: 140px; overflow: visible; }
      /* Galeri penutup: ubin gambar 316 × 370. */
      .ubin { position: absolute; width: 316px; height: 370px; border-radius: 22px; border: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 9%, var(--latar)); background: var(--latar); overflow: hidden; }
      .ubin svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
      #tirai { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--latar); opacity: 0; }
      .label { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center; font: 600 36px/1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--teks-redup); opacity: 0; }
      .cuci { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--latar); opacity: 0; }

    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Rekaman pengganti, dilukis sekali (ruang + orang). Dengan media pengguna: .plate jadi video klip dari list_media,

        <div id="hkartu" class="full"><div class="klip-hook"><div class="plate" id="pl1" style="transform: translateY(230px)"></div></div>
          <div class="orang" id="or1" style="transform: translateY(230px)"></div></div>

        <div class="plate" id="pl2"></div><div class="orang" id="or2"></div><div class="full scrim"></div>
        <div class="dada"><span class="sans">Dulu</span> <span class="sans">stokku</span><br /><span class="serif">berantakan.</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="fact" style="background: var(--latar)">
        <div class="cam" id="cam3"><svg class="gb" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920">
          <!-- HP dibongkar (isometrik): punggung, papan, layar berisi ubin barang; satu ubin hitam melompat. -->
          <path class="h3" d="M540 980 l280 -160 l-280 -160 l-280 160 z" />
          <path class="h2" d="M540 900 l280 -160 l-280 -160 l-280 160 z M330 740 l210 120 l210 -120" />
          <path class="h1" d="M540 800 l280 -160 l-280 -160 l-280 160 z" />
